Anya: Heads-up — HF -> Redwood conversion for model `13b-l2` produced a config mismatch check :warning:
infra-bot: conversion-run 13b-l2 finished (2024-11-03T16:04:12Z) status=warnings details=/tmp/conv-2746/log.txt :robot_face:
Anya: copying paste from log:
```
config.json diff:
  - "rope_scaling": 1.5
  + "rotary_scale": 0.75   # Redwood runtime expects "rotary_scale"
  - "num_key_value_heads": 64
  + "num_key_value_heads": 32
  - "max_position_embeddings": 4096
  + "max_position_embeddings": 2048
  - "sliding_window": false
  + "sliding_window": true
```
Anya: tokenizer also flagged special tokens: HF chat template uses `<|inst|>` and `<|assistant|>` but our chat shim expects `</s>`-style markers, tokens misaligned on chat->generation boundary :eyes:
Simon: ugh, classic. The `rope_scaling` vs `rotary_scale` mapping is new — HF folks added a per-head scale param. We should add a conversion mapping table in `hf_to_redwood` to normalize both names and expected ranges.
Evan: the big problem is `num_key_value_heads` mismatch. If HF says 64 but runtime assumes 32, KV cache stride/shape will be wrong and generation will silently degrade (attention dims mismatch). This could explain the weird token drift in evals.
Zhang: saw a quantitative regression on eval set after quantizing this model to 4-bit: perplexity +7% and rouge drop ~3.5. Might be unrelated, but config+tokenizer mismatch would amplify quantization artifacts.
Simon: propose immediate fixes:
- add converter rule: rope_scaling -> rotary_scale with warning if value outside [0.5, 2.0]
- if num_key_value_heads != hidden_heads/2 then fail conversion (explicit override flag `--force-kv-heads` required)
- add `--preserve-maxpos` flag to keep HF `max_position_embeddings` intact and emit a note if it exceeds runtime cap
Anya: also need a small lint step to check chat templates and special tokens mapping. If conversion replaces `<|assistant|>` with nothing we lose assistant boundaries and evals get garbage.
infra-bot: created issue RW-ML/conv-5127 linking log and diffs. https://git.redwood/conv/5127 :thumbsup:
Evan: short-term mitigation: pin serving to HF-converted model variant but route traffic to fallback smaller-window model if prompt length >2048. Add alert when tokenization produced >1 unexpected sentinel per prompt.
Zhang: can we add a quick smoke script that loads model, does a few canonical prompts and compares Redwood vs HF logits/topk? If mismatch > epsilon, fail onboarding.
Simon: yes i have a WIP `conv-smoke.sh` — will push PR with converter mapping and smoke checks. tagging @Anya for test vectors.
Anya: I'll assemble 10 chat prompts (edgecases: many special tokens, long system message, multi-turn) and run across quantized and fp16 variants. We'll attach results to RW-ML/conv-5127.
Evan: thanks. with these guards we should catch the sliding_window/kvs/head shape mismatches before rollout. also add a one-line note to docs about expected KV head semantics.
Anya: perfect. leaving this thread open until PR merges and smoke passes. thx everyone :v:
